capabilities: Turn domain-tagged notes into cards sorted into domain piles
Arrange, flip, and color cards on a board and draw labeled links between them
Add ink annotations (pen, line, rectangle, text) on top of the board
Store the board inside a Markdown note whose MOC body is generated as wiki links
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition flashcard tool; 'cards' are note cards arranged on a spatial board to compose a Map of Content.
extras: README is written entirely in Chinese. Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly); no mobile or iPad support. No marketplace install documented — users must build from source and copy dist files into .obsidian/plugins/. Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Building a MOC by hand in Markdown is tedious, and Obsidian Canvas is a separate file format that lacks domain-based card piles and freehand ink annotations.
summary: Card-board plugin that turns domain-tagged notes into draggable cards you pile, arrange, link, and annotate on a board to draft a Map of Content.
